description: Call this after building or deploying an MCP server or paid agent API, or when its listings may be out of date: we check it works (as verify_mcp does), then look it up in the official MCP Registry (and whether the listed version is current), Glama, PulseMCP, the x402 Bazaar, npm and PyPI, plus its server card, llms.txt and robots.txt (Smithery, PulseMCP, mcp.so and Claude's directory are listed with links to check by hand). Returns a score, what's missing or stale, an ordered fix plan and a ready-to-publish server.json. Read-only.

description.description: Optional: one-line description for the generated server.json (max 100 characters).

name.description: Optional: the server's display name, to search directories (defaults to the name the server reports).

npm.description: Optional: npm package name to check.

pypi.description: Optional: PyPI project name to check.

registry_name.description: Optional: its official MCP Registry name, e.g. com.example/server.

url.description: The MCP server's public https:// endpoint, e.g. https://example.com/mcp.

name: launch_check
title: Is this MCP server findable?
